jobs.title: Financial Analyst Accounts Payable FEMALE (E-Commerce) Dubai, Al Qusais 1
jobs.description:
**Accounts Payable / Financial Analyst FEMALE (Processing Orders) E-commerce**

**Sending quotations to customers,**   
**Bookings of collections,**   
**Payments reports and calculations,**  
**Making reports on our crm platform**

**- This job requires:**

* Clerical background and good in MS office
* Data entries , Accounting, Billing/Reconciliation work experience
* Clear pronunciation to communicate with customers
* Ability to work independent (quick learners)
* Flexible about time to assure that work is done on-time

we are **located in Dubai, Al Qusais**

**Make sure that you are:**

(1) available to join immediately only (currently unemployed)  
(2) relevant work experience

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: AED3,500.00 - AED5,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* ARE YOU FOCUSED AND WELL ORGANIZED? QUICK LEARNER? GOAL ORIENTED?
* YOUR AGE / CIVIL STATUS / NATIONALITY
* WHAT RELEVANT WORK EXPERIENCE YOU HAVE?
* ARE YOU READY TO JOIN? VISA STATUS?
* CLERICAL SKILLS /MS OFFICE?
* WHAT PART OF DUBAI YOU ARE CURRENTLY RESIDING?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
